honest_failure_analysis: Automated tools reliably detect high-energy slaps and dialogue keywords, but inherently stumble on: 1) In-media-res pronoun ambiguity where an opener lacks character context, 2) Truncated reaction beats where dialogue ends without the visual reaction shot, and 3) High-conflict squabbles between minor characters that lack core series stakes. Our human-in-the-loop review interface catches and remediates these exact failure modes in seconds.
